edges.sentence: On 2026-08-29, USA Today reported “Good Chop is offering a deal for new customers that includes free steaks for life and $100 off the first five boxes.”; on the same day, USA Today reported “New customers can get free Top Sirloin Steaks, Ranch Steaks or Tri Tip with every order for life, plus $100 off their first five boxes .”.

On 2026-08-29, USA Today reported “Customers can choose from over 100 items, including grass-fed beef, organic chicken, and wild-caught seafood.”; on the same day, USA Today reported “The service allows customers to customize their box from over 100 menu items, including USDA Choice and Prime steaks , 100% grass-fed beef, organic chicken, wild-caught seafood and more.”.
